selected.title: NatWest orders 30,000 staff to spend more time in the office
selected.summary: UK banking giant NatWest has told tens of thousands of employees to spend more time in the office in a move described as a kick in the teeth by union Unite.
selected.why: Major UK bank imposes broad return-to-office mandate affecting 30,000 employees.

reason: NatWest's return-to-office mandate raises arguable questions about whether post-pandemic hybrid work was a temporary concession or a structural shift in banking's future competitiveness and talent retention.
angle: Mandatory office time may reduce costs and control but will likely worsen talent competition against firms offering flexibility.
